body.name: Anchor
body.description: An anchor used to moor a ship. Long submerged beneath the sea, it’s now heavily rusted and worn.

body.name: Ancient Stingray Egg
body.description: An egg with a thick, leathery shell and horn-like spines jutting from its corners. Within, a fragile life still stirs faintly.

body.name: Antiquated Coin
body.description: An ancient coin bearing the marks of time. Its surface, worn smooth by countless hands, is inscribed with letters of unknown meaning.

body.name: Aquaglow Lantern
body.description: This lantern emits a light that never goes out, even underwater. With a shining coral at its center, a reflector focuses the light forward, illuminating the dark waters.
